name: GPU Volume Rendering with Shared Memory Caching and Phong Shading
definition: An interactive volume rendering method that uses CUDA to ray march through a 3D texture. It employs a shared memory cache to store voxel samples for a block of pixels, enabling neighbor access for gradient-based Phong shading. It supports front/back buffer inputs for depth-based ray initialization and optional plane slicing.
summary: This CUDA method batches voxel samples into shared memory to reduce bandwidth pressure while computing gradient-based Phong shading and supporting plane slicing.
